purpose: Ablation of a single knob against evidence/compare/boat_sixview_384. That run produced six views neutral grey to within 3 levels across channels while the conditioning photograph is warm brown (lum 44.4 vs 89-143). guidance_scale=1.0 means CFG is off, a documented cause of washed-out desaturated SD output, so this run changes guidance_scale ONLY. Everything else -- seed, steps, scheduler, reference and control conditioning scales, mesh, controls, conditioning -- is byte-identical, so any difference in the output is attributable to CFG alone.

mesh_provenance.conditioning_note: 512 not 1022: the model preprocessor resizes to 512, so a larger input is resampled twice and softens.

camera_semantics.margin_warning: IoU picks index 1 but only by 0.013 over index 3; bbox registration is a weak discriminator between blocky horizontal views. The evidence is the agreement with the barn and with the panda proven mapping {0:left,1:front,2:right,3:rear}, not this number alone.

oom_fallback.note: No 256 controls were built for this asset. A fallback would need its own control tensor and camera contract, so there is nothing to fall back to; an OOM here is a hard stop, not a retry.

prompt: high quality clean albedo reference of the same weathered wooden paddle steamer riverboat casino, consistent materials, consistent identity, flat neutral lighting

repair_proofs.note: Both are hardware defects of this GTX 1660 SUPER, not asset-specific, so they carry over unchanged.

canonical_orientation.evidence: glTF is Y-up by specification and Hunyuan3D emits glTF; control occupancy agrees, with front/rear at 0.898 and left/right at 0.635 for a subject 3.05x wider than tall.
canonical_orientation.supersedes: legacy_z_up, the builder's module default, which would lay the barn on its side

ablation.applied_by: workers/run_sixview_no_cudnn.py --guidance-scale, because the production worker passes guidance_scale=1.0 as a literal and exposes no config route
ablation.expected_cost: CFG doubles the UNet batch; baseline peaked at 2359 MB of 6144
ablation.success_measure: foreground mean RGB of view 0 moves toward the photograph [47.5,44.1,38.1] and gains warm separation R>G>B; QA colour gate saturation >= 0.08
